info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Operation Securities Fails Processing-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the intricate handling of securities fails within market operations. By utilizing this endpoint, financial institutions can efficiently identify, manage, and rectify instances of securities processing failures. Typical consumers of this API are trading platforms, financial service providers, and regulatory authorities who require a streamlined approach to maintain compliance and operational integrity. It allows organizations to enhance their workflows and ensure accuracy in securities transactions, ultimately improving the overall transaction lifecycle.

post.description: This operation handles the processing of securities fails, ensuring that all necessary steps are taken to resolve any issues that arise in the transaction lifecycle. It involves validating the fails, taking corrective actions, and updating the relevant records accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the processing of securities fails operations. It allows the submission of necessary data to resolve issues related to failed securities transactions.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.
